# netactuate_cloud_pool (Data Source)

Reads a Cloud Pool.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_cloud_pool" "example" {
  cloud_pool_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_pool_id` (Number) Cloud pool ID to read.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Cloud pool creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) Cloud pool description.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_updated` (String) Cloud pool last update timestamp.
- `name` (String) Cloud pool name.
- `private` (Number) Private flag as returned by the API.
